## What's Changed
### Application Performance Monitoring (APM)
* feat(internal/version): bump version to `v2.12.0-dev` by @kakkoyun in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5365
* feat(internal/version): bump version to `v2.12.0-dev.2` by @darccio in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5374
* ci: run workflows on changed components instead of every pull request by @kakkoyun in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5353
* feat(llmobs): add managed prompt retrieval by @PROFeNoM in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5298
* feat(contrib/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2): add LoadOptionsFunc implementation by @dcarbone in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/2095
* chore(internal/version): v2.12.0-dev.3 by @darccio in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5389
* chore(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc to v1.83.1 by @darccio in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5393
* fix(contrib/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2): decouple http.url assertions from SDK path serialization by @kakkoyun in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5413
* chore(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc to v1.83.2 by @kakkoyun in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5414
* ci: halve the floor on time-to-green by @kakkoyun in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5379
* feat(contrib/jackc/pgx.v5): monitor SQLi by @RomainMuller in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5427
* fix(appsec): report failed request blocks by @RomainMuller in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5377
* feat(llmobs): expose versioned prompt config by @PROFeNoM in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5333
* fix(contrib/sirupsen/logrus): honor DD_TRACE_128_BIT_TRACEID_LOGGING_ENABLED in orchestrion hook by @rarguelloF in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5428
* chore(deps): bump otel to v1.45.0 to fix GO-2026-6508 by @darccio in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5462
* chore(deps): bump the docker group across 4 directories with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5410
* chore(contrib/go-chi/chi): bump go-chi/chi to v1.5.5 by @kakkoyun in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5475
* docs(contrib): add apm-integrations skill and integration authoring guides by @rarguelloF in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5052

* fix(contrib/opensearch-project/opensearch-go.v4): bump opensearch-go to v4.7.0 by @darccio in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5510
* fix: smoke tests failing on main by @hannahkm in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5512
* fix(instrumentation/httptrace): updated query string obfuscation by @RomainMuller in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5518

* feat(contrib/net/http): support OpenTelemetry client semantics by @marcotc in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5203

* feat(contrib/labstack/echo.v4): support OpenTelemetry server semantics by @marcotc in https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5236
### General
